title: Just posted my first game! Can you give me some advice or feedback? It is called Reel Rush on roblox
author: saze169
selftext: I just released my first Roblox game, Reel Rush 🎣: 75 fish, shiny variants worth x3, boats, night-only fish and pets. Looking for honest feedback!  made it entirely with ai, the animations, the graphics, everything. I am new to to roblox games, claude made everything, using ad making skills, animating skills and marketing skills. I also made a promoting video with claude and an eleven labs voice. Do any of you have experience with my case? Nowadays do AI made games still work? considering all the other crazy ones that I respect alot. Im trying multiple things at the moment and made this in a few hours. what do you think?

comments.author: LuckyPawsStudio
comments.body: Honestly players don't care what tools you used, they care whether the first minute is fun. Night-only fish is a really good idea btw, it gives people a reason to come back. I'd make it super visible though, like a timer "night in 3:00" on screen, so players know to stick around. Shiny x3 variants are a nice touch too.

replies.author: saze169
replies.body: I made the day/night cycles pretty short about 20 minutes apart, should I make it real Time?
